title: Selected Topics Public Policy; Exploring Ethnic Politics and Conflict
description: In an age of specialization dividing theory and practice, international relations and local politics, staffing and public presentation - Dr/Senator/Ambassador Daniel Patrick Moynihan bridged all the divides. This course, led by former US Ambassador and now Maryland State Senator Jim Rosapepe who worked for Moynihan, current major policy issues - ethnic relations, government bureaucracy, geopolitical conflict, and US politics - will be explored through his research and direct experience. Students will gain insight into how to challenge conventional wisdom intellectually and politically, how to win and how to lose, how to learn by going wide not just deep, and how to write entertaining, compelling, and controversial policy analyses.
